recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. If BRR wants standardized characterization technique codes such as HPLC in core, that should be a separate terminology proposal for a dedicated characterization value set/code system rather than reuse of the structure technique terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-39596 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked BRR to add a SubstanceDefinition.characterization backbone rather than continuing to carry characterization details under SubstanceDefinition.structure, to use the approved technique/form/description/file details from the Jira comments, to make the description markdown, and to remove characterization remnants such as HPLC from the substance-structure-technique terminology.
initial_application: The current source had already added SubstanceDefinition.characterization and its approved child elements, and prior commits had removed characterization wording from the structure and representation definitions. The remaining missed application was that characterization.technique still reused the SubstanceStructureTechnique value-set binding and the active substance-structure-technique value set/code system still included HPLC plus a structure-or-characterization description.
additional_context: SubstanceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and belongs to BRR, so the edited resource and colocated terminology sources are current-build inputs. Earlier related issues FHIR-26635, FHIR-26940, and FHIR-32115 explain how characterization wording entered structure.technique and representation.type before FHIR-39596 moved characterization into its own backbone. BRR 2022-12-13 minutes confirm a 13-0-0 motion to approve FHIR-39596 as outlined in the Jira comments, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence FTS hits were found.
reconciliation: Removed the structure technique value-set binding from SubstanceDefinition.characterization.technique, removed HPLC from the SubstanceStructureTechnique code system, and changed the substance-structure-technique value set description to describe structure only.
source_changes: source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml: removed the SubstanceStructureTechnique example binding from SubstanceDefinition.characterization.technique while preserving the approved CodeableConcept element and HPLC textual example.
source/substancedefinition/codesystem-substance-structure-technique.xml: removed the HPLC concept from the complete SubstanceStructureTechnique code system.
source/substancedefinition/valueset-substance-structure-technique.xml: changed the value set description from structure-or-characterization to structure-only.
